title: H6003 (2020 Regular): Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2019-08-09; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2020/6003/BillText/Filed/PDF (LegiScan doc 2051747))
provenance.note: Introduced text (filed 2019-08-09); no passage vote. Operative changes are mostly deletions, so the quote is limited to the repeal clauses. Struck by the bill: s. 394.463(2)(d) (law enforcement may seize firearms when taking a person into involuntary examination); s. 790.065(13) (under-21 purchase ban and its officer/servicemember rifle exception); s. 790.0655(2)(c)-(d) (waiting-period exceptions for hunter safety course holders and officers buying rifles or shotguns). Section 2 (s. 394.4599) only conforms a cross-reference.
